Subject: Intro request: EU payments reference for Pegasus

Marissa / Karthik —

We're in late-stage discussions with Pegasus Payments (large EU payments processor). They asked for a short peer reference that speaks to: production reliability at scale, data handling in EU regions, and a quick note on integration effort (tokenization + event routing).

Are there any current customers in payments you can recommend for a ~30 minute call? Prefer someone in EU timezones and who can speak to a high-volume card processing use case. If you have a recent one-pager or a short redacted case example, please attach.

Timeline: they'd love to do the call this week or early next week — OOO window for their Procurement folks is tight.

Thanks — I can handle outreach, just want to make sure we surface the right advocate and call expectations.

— Hannah

Hannah —

Clara Rossi at VelvetPay is usually great for this profile. They run a payments gateway across EU/UK, very similar tokenization flows and high throughput (peak 1k tpm on some lanes). Clara's comfortable talking to prospects and we did a redacted write-up after their go‑live last quarter. I'm attaching the one-pager I keep in Sales Ops.

Quick notes: VelvetPay prefers a brief agenda ahead of calls and asks that we avoid sharing raw transaction-level logs (they'll provide a redacted case study PDF instead). No NDA required for a reference, but Procurement sometimes asks for a quick mutual NDA — we can flag if Pegasus asks.

Attaching: velvetpay-onepager.pdf
